_comment: Curated Π.Ε. for ΔΑΣΕ awarding units that the forest_authorities.json registry does not cover (DATA_DECISIONS 2026-07-27). Keys are whitespace-collapsed organization_name → units_operator_name exactly as stored in dase.sqlite (incl. Latin homoglyphs like 'TMHMA'/'OIKONOMIKO' and the en-dash in 'ΜΑΚΕΔΟΝΙΑΣ – ΘΡΑΚΗΣ'). Municipal/regional units pin to their municipality's Π.Ε.; ΔΑΣΑΡΧΕΙΟ ΦΟΥΡΝΑ is a genuine registry gap kept HERE (adding it to forest_authorities.json would feed the Anti-nero matcher). contract_overrides carry per-contract evidence for supra-regional awarders. ΑΔΜΗΕ's 4 transmission-line contracts stay unresolved on purpose: the works span multiple Π.Ε. (Γ.Μ. Λαμία–Πτολεμαΐδα, Θεσσαλονίκη–Αμύνταιο).
